description: This Java interface defines the structure and constants for a JSON Web Key (JWK), including methods to access key parameters and nested definitions for JSON field names used in JWK representation.

classes.name: JsonWebKey
classes.description: A Java interface representing a JSON Web Key with methods to retrieve key parameters such as type, algorithm, usage, ID, modulus, and exponent, following RFC 7517 standards.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the key type parameter of the JWK.

methods.name: getAlgorithm
methods.description: Returns the optional algorithm parameter of the JWK.

methods.name: getUsage
methods.description: Returns the optional usage parameter of the JWK.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the key ID parameter of the JWK.

methods.name: getModulus
methods.description: Returns the modulus (n) parameter of the RSA key.

methods.name: getExponent
methods.description: Returns the exponent (e) parameter of the RSA key.
